translation: Just before, I had lifted this one, the lower heddle

transcription: tʰam tɕe maŋlo nɯra tuwɣjoʁ ra tɕe tɕe kɯki
translation: Now, one has to lift the (warp threads connected to the) upper heddle (the heddle located `upstream', further away from the weaver),

transcription: ki tuwɣstu tɕe maŋlo nɯra tuwɣjoʁ tɕe kɯki
translation: one raises the (warp threads connected to the) upper (heddle) like this,

transcription: iɕqʰa tʰi ɣɯ tɤkɤrɤɕi nɯra tʰam tɕe pa ɯβra pjɯɕe ŋu tɕe
translation: now, it is the turn of the (threads) that had been pulled up just before to go down (on the vertical axis),

transcription: nɯnɯ tʰaχɕa ki tuwɣstu ɲɯwɣrʁe tɕe
translation: one inserts the shed stick

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ ɯsqar
translation: and the warp crossing...

transcription: kɯki ɯβra tuwɣrɤɕi tɕe tɕe kɯki ɣɯ ɯβra nɯ pa pjɯɕe ŋu
translation: It is the turn of this one to be pulled up, and of this one to go down

transcription: kɯki nɯ taʁ tuwɣrɤɕi ŋu tɕe
translation: One pulls up this one,

transcription: tɕe ki tuwɣstu tɕe cʰɯwɣlɤt ɲɯŋu
translation: and one (brings the warp crossing down) like this.

transcription: tɕe nɯ kɯ ɯsqar nɯ tʰaχɕa nɯ kɯ ɯsqar nɯ cʰɯsɯɣe ɲɯŋu
translation: And that, the shed stick, brings the warp crossing towards the weaver

transcription: tɕe ki tuwɣstu tɕe luwɣtaʁ
translation: and one weaves like this.

transcription: ki cʰɯwɣɣnda ra ma nɯmaʁnɤ mɤnɤrko tɕe
translation: One has to press this down, otherwise it is not strong/durable.

transcription: woja tɕe nɯ tufse tɕe tɕe kɯki ɯkɯki ldʑaŋkɯ tɤkɯɣe ki cʰɤrtaʁ tɕe tɕe kɯki
translation: Yes, it becomes like that, and when this green (thread) on the upper level (on the vertical axis) is enough,

transcription: kɯmaʁ nɯ ʁmɤrsɤr rmi tɕe nɯnɯ ɯβra ɕtuwɣlɤt tɕe
translation: the other one, (it is called `orange'), it is its turn to be brought to the upper level.

transcription: kɯki ɕnat kɯni kɯ ɯsqar kɤlɤt tunɯβrandʑi ŋu
translation: These two heddles are used to make the warp crossing.

transcription: cici ki tuwɣjoʁ cici ki tuwɣjoʁ
translation: Sometimes one raises this (heddle), sometimes one raises this (other heddle),

transcription: tɕe tɕe nɯ kɯ ɯsqar cʰɯlɤt tɕe tɕe tɯtaʁ luβze ŋu
translation: and it (makes) the warp crossing, to make the woven fabric.

transcription: tɕe kɯki ɯɕnat kɯki kɯ ɯmɯntoʁ kɤsɯβzu tunɯβre ŋu
translation: This heddle (the white one, the one furthest from the weaver, `upstream')\footnote{stu kɯ-maŋlo} is used to make the patterns.

transcription: ɯmɯntoʁ kɤβzu tɕe tɕe ki tuwɣstu tɕe nɤki ra wo
translation: To make the pattern, one does like this, one has to do that,

transcription: kɯki tɕe tɕe ɯmɯntoʁ nɯnɯ nɤkinɯ tɕeki tʰaχtsa apɯŋu tɕe ɯmɯntoʁ ra tɕe
translation: For coloured belts, it is necessary to have patterns,

transcription: nɯnɯ ɣɯ tɕe ki tuwɣstu tɕe
translation: one does like this,

transcription: iɕqʰa ldʑaŋkɯ pɯŋu tɕe tʰam tɕe kɯki ʁmɤrsɤr ki ɯβra tumda ŋu
translation: Just before, it was a green thread, and now it is the turn of this orange thread,

transcription: tɕe ki tufse ŋu tɕe
translation: it becomes like this.

transcription: tɕe ki tuwɣtɕɤt tɕe iɕqʰa nɯ
translation: One picks it up.\footnote{This sentence was explained as: ` It is time to pick up the warp threads that are orange, and to make disappear the green ones in the lower layer.' (ʁmɤrsɤr kɯ-ŋu ɣɯ ɯ-ʁjar nɯ tú-wɣ-tɕɤt to-mda, ldʑaŋkɯ nɯ pjɯ́-wɣ-sɯ-ɕqhlɤt ra)}

transcription: iɕqʰa ldʑaŋkɯ ʁɟa ʑo pɯŋu tʰam tɕe ʁmɤrsɤr ʁɟa ʑo ɲɯwɣβzu ra
translation: Just before, it was completely green, now one has to make it completely orange.

transcription: ɯkɯki ɯrkoz kɤtʰɯta ŋu ma
translation: I prepared this one specially (for you),

transcription: nɯmaʁnɤ pɤjkʰu ajaʁ kɤsɯtaʁ kʰro mɯjkhɯ ma ajaʁ mɯjmna
translation: because otherwise I can't weave very well with my hands, as my hands have not recovered.

transcription: ki tuwɣstu tɕe kɯki tɯrɣɯt tɯrɣɯt kuwɣlɤt tɕe tuwɣtɕɤt ra
translation: One has to pick thread by thread like this.

transcription: tɯjaʁ kɯ tuwɣznɯrdoʁ ra
translation: One has to pick (the threads) by hand.

transcription: tɕe mɯaɲaj wo kɤtaʁ
translation: Weaving is not quick.

transcription: cʰɯjɤɣ ʑo me
translation: It never finishes.

transcription: tɕe iɕqʰa kɯki ɯmdoʁ ki pɯŋu tɕe tʰam tɕe tɕe kɯki ɯβra cʰɯwɣlɤt ŋu
translation: Just before it was this colour (green), now it is this one's (orange) turn.

transcription: woja tɕe tɕe kɯki zgrɯl nɯ kɯ kɯki tɯldʑa tɯldʑa nɯnɯ kɯki kusɯɤʑɯrje tɕe zgrɯl nɯ kɯ nɯ pjɯnɯβre ra
translation: The coil stick is used to (maintain) aligned the (warp threads) one by one

transcription: tɕe kɯki lɤaŋgɤrŋgɤr zgrɯl nɯ lo luwɣstʰoʁ qʰe tɕelo luwɣsɯxɕe qʰe
translation: When it (the woven cloth) become too close (to the coil stick), one pushes the coil stick upstream (away from the weaver on the warp axis), one makes it go upstream,

transcription: kɯki nɯ tʰi cʰɯɣi qʰe
translation: and this one (the woven cloth) comes downstream (towards the weaver on the warp axis),

transcription: ʑɯrɯʑɤri ki tufse qhe ɯpa ri lɤkɤtaʁ nɯ ɯpa ri luɕe
translation: Progressively, the woven (cloth) underneath (on the vertical axis) goes upstream (away from the weaving) like this,

transcription: mɤkɤtaʁ nɯ ɯtaʁ ri tʰi cʰɯɣi ŋu
translation: whereas the (warp) that has not be woven comes downstream

transcription: tɕe ki tufse tɕe kɯki
translation: like this,

transcription: tɕe ldʑaŋkɯ nɯnɯ nɯɣɤmeta tɕe ʁmɤrsɤr nɯra tɤtɕata
translation: I removed the green (threads), and picked up the orange ones.

transcription: tɕe nɯ kɯfse ʁɟa ʑo lumnɤt nɤ lumnɤt qʰe tɕe cʰɯβze ɕti wo
translation: (the process) repeats all the way like that again and again, and the cloth (becomes woven)

transcription: tɕe kɯki kɤtaʁ ɣɯ ɯkɯkɯki tɤɣle rmi
translation: And this is called the warp beam.

transcription: ɯkɯkɯki tɤɣle rmi tɕe kukutɕu ɲɯraʁ ra
translation: This is called the warp beam, (the warp threads) are stuck here.

transcription: nɯtɕu kuwɣβraʁ qʰe cʰɯsɯɣe ŋu
translation: One attaches (the warp) there, (to maintain the tension of the warp) so that (the shed sticks) can bring the (warp crossing) downstream.

transcription: nɯ ɕɯŋgɯ tɕe ɯtʰoʁ ri lukɯtaʁ tɕe
translation: Previously, one used to weave on the ground,

transcription: tɤtsʰoʁ pjɯwɣno tɕe
translation: one would drive pegs,

transcription: nɤki laʁjɯɣ ɲɯwɣɕar qʰe nɯ ɯku cʰɯsɯɤmtɕoʁnɯ qʰe pjɯɣndanɯ qʰe
translation: One would look for a stick, and they would sharpen its extremity, pound on it

transcription: tɕe sɤtɕʰa kɯɣɤrɤβ tsa ri
translation: and on a slope,

transcription: kɯ ri ci pjɯɲɟoʁnɯ pjɯsɯɤtsanɯ
translation: they would fix one on the left, insert it (into the ground),

transcription: ndi ri li ci pjɯsɯɤtsanɯ qʰe tɕe
translation: and another one on the right.

transcription: tɤɣle nɯnɯtɕu cʰɯwɣsɯɣraʁ qʰe tɕe cʰɯwɣtaʁ pɯŋu
translation: one would then fix the warp beam there, and weave.

transcription: tɕeri kukutɕu tɕe nɯra kɤstu mɯjkʰɯ ma kʰa ɲɯɕti tɕe
translation: But here we cannot do it like that, because it is a house,

transcription: tɕe ɯkɯkɯki atʰaʁra ɯtsʰɤt ŋu
translation: and thus I (use) this as a replacement for the warp beam pegs.\footnote{Tshendzin mistakenly said \ipa{a-tɤɣle} `my warp beam' instead of \ipa{a-tʰaʁra} `my warp beam peg'}

transcription: kɯki ni kɯki χcʰoʁe tɯka ki atʰaʁra ɯtsʰɤt ŋu
translation: These two, one on the left and one on the right, I (use) them as a replacement for the warp beam pegs.

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ tɕu ɲɯsɯɣraʁa qʰe maʁ
translation: and I fixed (the warp beam) on it. No !

transcription: kɯki ni tɤtsʰoʁ pjɯwɣno pɯra tɕe nɯnɯ tʰaʁra tukɯti ŋu
translation: One used to have to drive pegs (into the ground), and these are called warp beam pegs.

transcription: kɯki scʰo kɯki ni tʰaʁra tukɯti ŋu
translation: This and this, these two are called warp beam pegs.

transcription: kɯki tɤɣle tukɯti ŋu
translation: This one is called a warp beam.

transcription: kɯki laʁjɯɣ tɤɣle tukɯti ŋu
translation: This stick is called a warp beam.

transcription: kɯki ni tɤtsʰoʁ pjɯwɣno nɯ ɕɯŋgɯ ɯsɤɣraʁ χcʰoʁe kɯni tʰaʁra tukɯti ŋu
translation: And these two pegs that one drives (into the ground), formerly used to fix (the loom) on the left and on the right, are called the warp beam pegs.

transcription: tɕe cʰɯwɣtaʁ qʰe tɕe kɯki ɯsqar ki tʰɯari qʰe
translation: While weaving, when this warp crossing goes towards the weaver,

transcription: ɯjlɤβ kɯ kuwɣrʁe
translation: one inserts the weft towards the left,

transcription: li ci tʰɯari qʰe ɯjlɤβ ndi ɲɯwɣrʁe qʰe
translation: and when another (warp crossing) goes towards the weaver, one inserts the weft towards the right.

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ kɯfse lukɯtaʁ ŋu
translation: One weaves like that.

transcription: tɕe tʰaχɕa ra kɯnɤ ʑakastaka nɯma tu
translation: Each of the shed sticks have their own role.

transcription: ma kɯki maŋtʰi ki kɯ ki tuste tɕe ɯpa ki tuwɣstu tɕe cʰɯwɣsɯqʰrɯt ŋu
translation: This one, the one furthest downstream (closest to the weaver), one does like this underneaths and clears the shed. %9:45

transcription: cʰɯwɣsɯqʰrɯt qhe tɕendɤre nɤkinɯ ɯsqar nɯ tʰi cʰɯnɤm ŋu
translation: It clears the shed and it pulls the warp crossing downstream.

transcription: ɯsqar nɯ tʰi cʰɯnɤm qʰe tɕe kɯki tʰaʁmu kɤrʁe tukʰɯ ŋu
translation: it pulls the warp crossing downstream, and it becomes possible to insert the weft beater.

transcription: kɯki tʰaʁmu kɯnɤ ɯkɯkɯki si pjɯŋu ra
translation: Concerning the weft beater, this (part) must be made of wood.

transcription: kɯki si ɕkrɤz nɯmaʁnɤ mbraj pjɯŋu ra ma
translation: Its wood has to be either oak or red birch.

transcription: nɯmaʁ nɯra si nɯra ʑo tɕe mɤɣnde
translation: Otherwise, the wood is too light and doesn't tamp well

transcription: tɕe kɯki ɯcʰɯsɤɣnda ɯstu kɯki ɕom ɲɯwɣβzu tɕe
translation: This part, the place which is used to tamp, is made of iron.

transcription: ɯkɯki nɤkinɯ kɯki χcʰoʁe ki kɯfse tɯka kɯɤmtɕoʁ tu tɕe kutɕu
translation: On the right and on the left, there are pointy parts, here,

transcription: tɕe nɯ ɯŋgɯ ri pjɯsɯɤtsanɯ
translation: and (the iron blade) is inserted inside.

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ tʰaʁmu ŋu nɯmaʁnɤ nɤkinɯ mɤɣnde
translation: That is the weft beater, otherwise it doesn't tamp well.

transcription: ki mɤɣnde tɕe tɯkɤtaʁ nɯ mpɯ tɕe mɤpe
translation: It doesn't tamp well and one's woven cloth is soft and not good.

transcription: kɯki atʰaʁmu ki χpɤltɕin kɯ naβzu ŋu
translation: This weft beater of mine has been made by Dpalcan.

transcription: ki tuwɣstu qʰe ɯsqar nɯ ntsɯ cʰɯɕe qʰe kɯki
translation: One does like that, and the warp crossing goes downstream,

transcription: cici taʁ tuɣi cici pa pjɯɕe qʰe tɕe
translation: sometimes it comes upwards (vertically), sometimes it goes downwards,

transcription: tɕe nɯ kɯfse luwɣtaʁ ɕti wo
translation: That is how one weaves.

transcription: nɯ mɤɕtʂa mɤkʰɯ
translation: Otherwise it doesn't work.

transcription: kɯki tʰɯqʰrɯta ri tɕe kɯki ʑakastaka ɯmdoʁ cʰɯɣi ŋu
translation: When I cleared this, each of the colours have come downstream.

transcription: kɯki ni tɤjoʁa tɕe tɕendɤre ɯmdoʁ kɯɤtʂoʁloʁ tuɣi ɕti ma nɯ mɤɕtʂa mɤkʰɯ
translation: When I raised these two, (threads) of mixed colours come up, otherwise it will not work.

transcription: kutɯtso ɯɲɯkʰɯ
translation: Can you understand ?

transcription: tɕe kɯki nɯ ma ki kɤfɕɤt me
translation: Apart from this, I don't have anything to say.

transcription: kɯki sɤrndzo ŋu
translation: This is a warping frame.

transcription: tɕe kɯki ɯkɯspoʁ ŋu tɕe
translation: and this is its mortise,

transcription: kɯki kɯfse ɯjaʁ nɯ ɯɲɯsɤrʁe ŋu
translation: where one inserts its arms, which is like this.

transcription: tɕe kɤtaʁ nɯ kɯrɲɟi tɤra tɕe
translation: When one needs to weave a long piece,

transcription: tɕe kɯrɲɟi ci tɕe ɯjaʁ nɯ pjɯwɣrʁe tɕe kuwɣtʰɯ ŋu
translation: One inserts its arm (in the mortise) that is at a longer (distance) to start warping. %00:13

transcription: kɯxtɯt tɤra tɕe tɕe kɯki tʰi cʰɯwɣscɤt tɕe
translation: When one needs a shorter one, one moves (the arm) `downwards'.

transcription: tɕe kukutɕu atɤxtɯt qʰe tɕe kɤtaʁ nɯ kɯnɤ xtɯt
translation: If it is short here, the woven fabric will also be short.

transcription: tɕe ɯtɤrtaʁ nɯ ɯtsʰɤt nɯ kɯkɯra ŋu ɯkɯkɯra
translation: Instead of tree branches, one (uses) these

transcription: kɯkɯra ɯtɤrtaʁ nɯ ɯtsʰɤt ŋu
translation: These are used instead of tree branches.

transcription: nɯ ɕɯŋgɯ tɕe si ki kɯfse kɯɤrtaʁ ɲɯwɣpʰɯt pɯŋu ri
translation: Previously, one used to chop a forked tree like that,

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ pjɯnɯɬoʁ ɲɯɕti tɕe
translation: but it would come off,

transcription: nɯ ɯqʰu tɕe kɯki kɯfse tɤsɯβzuta
translation: Later I had it made like this.

transcription: tɕe kɯkɯra ɯtɤrtaʁ nɯ ɯtsʰɤt ŋu
translation: These are used instead of tree branches.

transcription: kɯki sɤrndzo ɯjaʁ ŋu
translation: This is the warping frame's arms,

transcription: kɯki sɤrndzo ɯphoŋbu ŋu
translation: This is the warping frame's body.

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ kuwɣtʰɯ tɕe nɤkinɯ tʰɤstɯɣ kɯzri kɯra nɯ nɤki
translation: When one winds threads, the length that is needed (how long is needed), %00:43

transcription: kɤtaʁ tʰɤstɯɣ kɯzri kɯra nɯ ʁnɯtɣa tu χsɤtɣa tu kɯβdetɣa kɯmŋutɣa tɕe tɯ ldtudɤn ʑo ŋu
translation: The length that is needed for weaving, it can be two, three, four, five handspans, more and more.

transcription: tɕe tɯŋga ɯspa tɤŋu tɕe kɯki sɤrndzo mɤrtaʁ
translation: When it is for (making) clothes, this warping frame is not enough.

transcription: tɕe kɯrɲɟɯ ldrɲɟi ʑo sqamnɯtɣa sqafsumtɣa sqaβdetɣa nɯ kɯfse kuwɣtʰɯ mɤɕtʂa tɯŋga kɯwxti mɤrtaʁ
translation: Unless one winds very long threads, twelve, thirteen, fourteen handspans long, otherwise it is not large enough for clothes.

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ nɯnɯ tɕe tɕe ki tuwɣstu cʰɯwɣrɤtɣa
translation: One measures by handspans like that.

transcription: tɕe tʰɤstɯɣ kɯra nɯ cʰɯwɣrɤtɣa tɕe
translation: One measures by handspans how much is needed.

transcription: ŋotɕu kɯra nɯtɕu tɕe tɕe ki ɯjaʁ ɲɯwɣrʁe ŋu tɕe
translation: and one inserts the arm at the place corresponding to the length that is needed.

transcription: ɯkɯki kɯki nɯ kɯβdetɣa ŋu
translation: This one is at four handspans.

transcription: aʑo atɣa xtɯt ɕti qhe ʑaʑa tuβze ɕti ma
translation: My handspan is short, it gets quickly

transcription: ki χsɤtɣa ŋu
translation: This is three handspans.

transcription: ki tuwɣstu tɕe aʑɯɣ qhe kɯki
translation: One does like that, as for me,

transcription: kɯki ɯro kɯki χsɤtɣa aʑɯɣ kutɕu mɯjzɣɯt
translation: there is this remainder here, my handspans do not reach here.

transcription: χsɤtɣa tɕe tɕe kɯki kɯβdetɣa ɲɯŋu
translation: Three handspans, this is four handspans,

transcription: kɯki kɯmŋɤtɣa ɯkɯki alɤzɣɯt tɕe kɯtʂɤɣtɣa
translation: This is five handspans, and if one reaches this one, it is six handspans.

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ tɕe tɕe nɤki kɤtaʁ kɤthɯ tɕe tɕe ki tuwɣstu ra tɕe tɕe
translation: One winds threads like this,

transcription: nɤmɲaʁ ɯʁɤri kuthia tɕe apɯtɯmtɤm
translation: I will pull the threads in front of you (your eyes), so you can see.

transcription: atʰaχɕa xcat ʑo
translation: I have a lot of shed sticks !

transcription: kɤtaʁ kɤthɯ tɕe ki tuwɣstu tɕe
translation: One winds thread like this,

transcription: tɤri ʁnɯldʑa ki tuwɣstu ra ma
translation: one has to do like this with two threads,

transcription: taʁ ci tuɣi pa ci pjɯɕe ra
translation: one has to come up, an the (other) one has to go down.

transcription: tɕe ki tuwɣstu tɕe kutɕu ɯsɤsɤʑa nɯ kutɕu kuwɣβraʁ kutɕu kuwɣβraʁ ŋu
translation: Its initial part is attached here like this.

transcription: ki tuwɣstu tɕe tɕe kuwɣβraʁ tɕe tɕe
translation: One attaches it like this.

transcription: ki tuwɣstu tɕe tɕe kutɕu luwɣtsɯm ŋu
translation: One brings it up here (upstream) like this.

transcription: kukutɕu luwɣtsɯm tɕe tɕe kukutɕu ki tuwɣstu
translation: One brings it up there this this.

transcription: ci ɯlɤwɣtsɯm tɕe kɯki pa pjɯwɣtsɯm
translation: Each time one brings it upstream, one brings this one underneath.

transcription: ɯlocu nɯ ɣɯ tɕe tɕe
translation: And upstream,

transcription: ŋgɤrom nɯ apɯŋu tɕe tɕe nɯ ʁnɯldʑa ma ɯtɤrtaʁ mɤra
translation: If one (weaves using the) plainweave (Danbazi \zh{单巴子}) method, only two sticks are needed,

transcription: tʰaχtsa cho tɯtaχte nɯ tɕe tɕe kɯki kɯβdeldʑa ra
translation: If one (weaves) colored belts or (uses the) twill (Xiewenzi \zh{斜纹子}) method, four sticks are needed.

transcription: tɕe nɯnɯ tɕe ki tuwɣstu tɕe ɯlocu nɯ tɕe ki tuwɣstu tɕe
translation: and one does like this upstream,
